literature_notes: Both ledger lines (L1, L2) describe the same α11-EGFP construct from PMC12965127. ITGA11 is a Type I single-pass transmembrane protein (signal peptide 1–22, extracellular 23–1141, TM 1142–1164, intracellular 1165–1188). The EGFP is fused to the C-terminus, which is unambiguously intracellular: the paper's central experiment swaps the cytoplasmic tails of α2 and α11, and the chimeric constructs (α2Xα11C-mCherry, α11Xα2C-EGFP) make sense only if the fluorescent protein tracks the cytoplasmic tail. No ledger line reports any insertion on the extracellular face of ITGA11. Zero extracellular tag sites are supported.

literature_other_positions.note: α11-EGFP is a C-terminal fusion; the EGFP tracks the cytoplasmic tail (intracellular residues 1165–1188), confirmed by cytoplasmic-tail swap chimeras in the same study.
